page.name: certificates
page.div: Upload a single-page PDF with blank spaces for your event details. Add fields below, then drag them into place. Save the event before printing. Your PDF artwork and page size are preserved. This PDF takes priority over HTML templates.

group.string: HTML Template (fallback when no PDF is uploaded)

field.name: certificate_template
field.placeholder: Optional: paste an HTML template using {{company}}, {{event_name}}, {{event_date}}, {{topics}} and {{presented_by}}

page.div: The template is stored exactly as typed, so a complete HTML document (with its own <style> block) can be pasted here. Leave empty to use the default certificate layout. The template is used once per attending company.

field.name: certificate_template_html
field.placeholder: Legacy rich-text template (only used when the HTML source above is empty)

page.name: signup_sheets
page.div: Upload a single-page signup sheet PDF, including your blank attendance area. Add text fields or the instructor signature, then drag and resize them on the PDF. One sheet is printed for each company and topic. Save the event before printing. This PDF takes priority over HTML signup templates.

group.string: HTML Template (fallback when no PDF is uploaded)

field.name: signup_sheet_template
field.placeholder: Optional: paste an HTML template using {{company}}, {{event_name}}, {{event_date}}, {{topic}}, {{start_time}}, {{finish_time}}, {{instructor}}, {{instructor_signature}} and {{presented_by}}

page.div: The template is stored exactly as typed, so a complete HTML document (with its own <style> block) can be pasted here. Leave empty to use the default signup sheet layout. The template is used once per company and topic.

field.name: signup_sheet_template_html
field.placeholder: Legacy rich-text template (only used when the HTML source above is empty)
